name: Kitty Witchy
description:
About This Game

In an enchanted world full of mystery, a young witch and her magical cat embark on an unforgettable journey. Kitty Witchy is a 3D narrative puzzle adventure where you’ll solve enchanting challenges, uncover hidden secrets, and help the little witch find her way back home.

Explore a cozy, magical world

From the Dreamy Forest to the Enchanted Dusk, Kitty Witchy features a variety of magical environments designed to make you pause, breathe, and lose yourself in the calm of its cozy world.

Solve puzzles with enchanted stones

Puzzles revolve around moving magical stones across a three-dimensional board. Freeze water with ice stones, burn bushes with fire stones, or summon your cat Cosmo to help you solve complex challenges. Put your mind to the test using mechanics like portals, pressure plates, and more to open new paths and reach the end of each level!

Use Cosmo’s magical abilities

Your magical cat Cosmo can help you reach inaccessible places, uncover hidden secrets, and solve unique puzzles. Switch between the witch and her feline companion to progress and interact with the environment in creative ways, but remember… cats don’t like water!

Discover the witch’s story and her secrets

As you explore, you’ll meet the inhabitants of this mysterious world, from the Eternal Guardian to the Star Gardener, and uncover the bond that ties the witch to her feline companion, as well as the true nature of the world and the purpose of her journey. A tender, magical adventure that will stay with you long after it ends.
short_desc: A little lost witch, a magical cat, and a world full of secrets. Kitty Witchy is a 3D narrative puzzle adventure game. Join the witch and solve puzzles with the help of her cat, uncover the secrets of this universe, and find the way back home.
